steps.title: 額定量分離：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「額定量分離」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for separate ratings.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「額定量分離」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。連續電流、短時耐受與分斷電流是不同額定。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「將負載與故障情境分別對應額定。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for separate ratings, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Continuous, short-time withstand and interrupting currents differ. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Map load and fault cases to separate ratings. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 將負載與故障情境分別對應額定。
steps.observationEn: Map load and fault cases to separate ratings.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「額定量分離」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping separate ratings verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「額定量分離」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「將負載與故障情境分別對應額定。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for separate ratings; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 連續電流、短時耐受與分斷電流是不同額定。
knowledge.textEn: Continuous, short-time withstand and interrupting currents differ.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 將負載與故障情境分別對應額定。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Map load and fault cases to separate ratings. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設接點平均速度 1 m/s，10 mm 行程需 10 ms；50 Hz 的半週期也為 10 ms，但相等不代表可可靠分斷，還需電流零點與暫態恢復電壓分析。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed mean contact speed 1 m/s, 10 mm travel takes 10 ms, equal to a 50 Hz half-cycle. Equality does not prove interruption: current zero and transient recovery voltage still matter.

quiz.question: 審查「額定量分離」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for separate ratings?
options: 連續電流、短時耐受與分斷電流是不同額定。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「額定量分離」的驗證。
只調整「額定量分離」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Continuous, short-time withstand and interrupting currents differ.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping separate ratings verification.
Tuning the displayed separate ratings result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 連續電流、短時耐受與分斷電流是不同額定。 將負載與故障情境分別對應額定。
quiz.explanationEn: Continuous, short-time withstand and interrupting currents differ. Map load and fault cases to separate ratings.

steps.title: 額定量分離：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「額定量分離」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

summary: 以真空滅弧、接點運動與恢復電壓串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect vacuum interruption, contact motion and recovery voltage through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
